systems.owner: Ministério dos Transportes, Telecomunicações e Economia Digital; financed by the World Bank, USD 60 million for the whole programme
systems.tiers: planned: the minister called for fibre to link urban centres, rural areas, schools, health units and government institutions to the national network

note: The national launch of the WARDIP programme: the minister calls for fibre to link government institutions to the national network, an intention with no local government office named and nothing built.
